name: Xenofeli Detective Agency
source:
Rei Knox, a 23 years old university graduate, was stranded in a small town of nowhere after he took the wrong bus on his solo traveling trip. Robbed of all of his possessions, he was desperate to find a way to be back home, until he found a job vacancy flyer on the road as an temporary assistant. He followed the address on the flyer only to find a detective agency and its' strange owner.

Wait, detective agency, you said?! 

[From [url=https://eikitaraaaa.itch.io/xenofeli-detective-agency]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Rei Knox今年23岁，刚从大学毕业。他独自旅行时搭错了巴士，结果被困在一座偏僻小镇。身上所有财物都被抢走后，他急着寻找回家的办法，直到在路边看到一张临时助理的招聘传单。他按地址找去，发现那里是一家侦探事务所，还有一位古怪的老板。

等等，你说侦探事务所？！
